title: Tesla kills $41,990 Model Y AWD: all-wheel drive now costs $8,000 more
summary: Tesla has pulled the $41,990 Model Y All-Wheel Drive from its US online configurator. The cheapest dual-motor Model Y you can order now is the Model Y Premium AWD at $49,990, an $8,000 jump. The trim lasted just over nine months. Tesla launched it in early February, and it’s gone without a word from the company. more…

title: Tesla stops selling every Cybertruck except the $109,990 Cyberbeast
summary: Tesla is now only selling one version of the Cybertruck in the US: the tri-motor Cyberbeast, which just got another $7,500 price hike to $109,990. The Dual Motor and Premium AWD trims are still listed on Tesla’s configurator, but both are greyed out and can’t be selected. So the cheapest Cybertruck you can order today costs $109,990, up 57% from $69,990 in early August. more…

title: Zonveer ZX3 review: one of the best-value electric dirt bikes for beginners
summary: The Zonveer ZX3 is one of the best values I’ve seen in electric off-road riding, and one of the most fun things I’ve ridden to date – value for the dollar. Its Black Friday sale brings the 2,800W electric dirt bike down to $1,299, $500 off its $1,799 list price. For that money, you get a 1,200Wh battery, dual hydraulic disc brakes, and full suspension in a 130 lb package. That’s a great entry point for beginners. more…
